mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_PAY ( pay_amount, pay_method, pay_date, pay_status ) VALUES ( #{payAmount}, #{payMethod}, NOW(), #{payStatus} )

INSERT INTO UB_MATCHING ( matching_start, matching_state, mentor_number, mentee_number, subject_number, pay_id, matching_cancel, matching_can_reason ) VALUES ( NOW(), '매칭중', #{mentorNumber}, #{menteeNumber}, (SELECT usm.subject_number FROM UB_MEMBER um LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTOR usm ON um.survey_number = usm.survey_number WHERE um.member_number = #{mentorNumber}), #{payId}, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PAY_ID AS payId, p.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, p.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, DATE_FORMAT(p.PAY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS payDate, p.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus FROM UB_PAY p JOIN UB_MATCHING m ON p.PAY_ID = m.PAY_ID WHERE m.MENTEE_NUMBER = #{memberNumber} ORDER BY p.PAY_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT P.PAY_ID as payId, P.PAY_AMOUNT as payAmount, P.PAY_METHOD as payMethod, DATE_FORMAT(P.PAY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as payDate, P.PAY_STATUS as payStatus, M.MEMBER_ID as memberId, M.MEMBER_NAME as memberName, F.FILE_NAME as fileName, MT.MENTORING_GOAL as purpose FROM UB_PAY P LEFT JOIN UB_MATCHING MAT ON P.PAY_ID = MAT.PAY_ID LEFT JOIN UB_MEMBER M ON MAT.MENTOR_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN UB_FILE F ON M.FILE_NUMBER = F.FILE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN UB_MENTORING MT ON M.MEMBER_NUMBER = MT.MENTOR_NUMBER WHERE MAT.MENTEE_NUMBER = #{memberNumber} ORDER BY P.PAY_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT P.PAY_ID as payId, P.PAY_AMOUNT as payAmount, P.PAY_METHOD as payMethod, DATE_FORMAT(P.PAY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as payDate, P.PAY_STATUS as payStatus, F.FILE_NAME as fileName FROM UB_PAY P LEFT JOIN UB_MATCHING MAT ON P.PAY_ID = MAT.PAY_ID LEFT JOIN UB_MEMBER M ON MAT.MENTOR_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN UB_FILE F ON M.FILE_NUMBER = F.FILE_NUMBER WHERE P.PAY_ID = #{payId}
